items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Count Von Luckner I think the guy's name was.

ctx.x: And as I say, Art Tatum was the intermission piano player. You know he couldn't see very well. He saw just sort of faintly, he saw sort of foggy like. He couldn't hardly discern anything. You know little faint shadows was about all Art could see.
And I mentioned one day to Art that I was reading a book about U boats. Count Von Luckner I think the guy's name was.
